name: Clone Gravity Form Entry
author: Techeshta

sections.description:
Clone Gravity Form Entry is a powerful Gravity Forms addon that simplifies entry management by allowing you to effortlessly duplicate/clone form entries with a single click. This plugin is invaluable for workflow optimization, data backup strategies, and entry management.

Key Features

Clone Gravity Form Entry saves time and eliminates repetitive data entry:

  • One-Click Cloning – Duplicate any Gravity Form entry instantly from the entries list
  • Complete Duplication – Copies all field data and custom metadata automatically
  • Zero Configuration – Works seamlessly with your existing Gravity Forms setup
  • Security-First – Built with WordPress security best practices including nonce verification and capability checks
  • Intuitive Interface – Simple “Clone” link on each entry for easy access
  • Search & Filter Compatible – Works seamlessly with Gravity Forms’ powerful search and filtering capabilities

Use Cases

  • Testing & QA – Quickly create duplicate entries to test form workflows and validation rules
  • Data Backup Strategy – Create instant backups of important form submissions
  • Bulk Operations – Speed up data migration and duplication tasks
  • Template Entries – Use template-like entries and clone them for similar submissions
  • Data Recovery – Rapidly duplicate critical entries as a redundancy measure

Why Choose Clone Gravity Form Entry?

✓ Performance Optimized – Minimal overhead, loads stylesheets only when needed
✓ WordPress Standards – Built following WordPress coding standards (PHPCS-compliant)
✓ Official APIs – Uses Gravity Forms official API for maximum compatibility
✓ Developer Friendly – Well-documented, clean code, and actionable hooks
✓ Translation Ready – Fully internationalized for global support
✓ Free Forever – No premium upsells, completely free to use

📖 Full Documentation
sections.installation:
From Your WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins >Add New
  2. Search for Clone Gravity Form Entry
  3. Click on Install Now Button
  4. Click on Activate Now After Installed in the Backend

From WordPress.org

  1. Download Clone Gravity Form Entry
  2. Upload the ‘clone-gravity-form-entry’ folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Activate Clone Gravity Form Entry plugin from your plugins page
sections.faq:
Should I Require a Gravity Form to Get the Benefits of this Plugin?

Yes, you require a Gravity form plugin to use this addon plugin.

Is Clone Gravity Form Entry Plugin Free to Use?

Yes! Clone Gravity Form Entry plugin is free.

Do You Have a Documentation?

Yes, we have documentation that you can check out here.

Where Can I Ask for Help?

Please reach out via the official support forum on WordPress.org.

  • [Security] Replaced raw SQL queries with official Gravity Forms API (GFAPI) for entry duplication.
  • [UX] Added Post-Redirect-Get pattern to prevent duplicate submissions on browser refresh.
  • [UX] Implemented a beautiful, translatable success message notice on cloning completion.
